sn46.5:1.2: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn46.5:1.4: kittāvatā nu kho bhante bojjhaṅgāti vuccantīti.
sn46.5:1.5: bodhāya saṃvattantīti kho bhikkhu tasmā bojjhaṅgāti vuccantīti.
sn46.5:1.6: idha bhikkhu bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ …pe…
sn46.5:1.7: upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn46.5:1.8: tassime satta bojjhaṅge bhāvayato kāmāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati bhavāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati avijjāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati.
sn46.5:1.10: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
sn46.5:1.11: bodhāya saṃvattantīti bhikkhu tasmā bojjhaṅgāti vuccantīti.
